description: Verify a single US address for deliverability and return USPS-standardized/corrected components (ZIP+4, DPV codes, county, lat/lon). Pass structured components (primary_line, city, state, zip_code) OR a single freeform `address` string — not both. Example: lob_verify_address({ primary_line: "185 Berry St", secondary_line: "Ste 6100", city: "San Francisco", state: "CA", zip_code: "94107", _apiKey: "your-key" }) or lob_verify_address({ address: "185 Berry St Ste 6100 San Francisco CA 94107", _apiKey: "your-key" })

examples.address: 185 Berry St Ste 6100 San Francisco CA 94107

_apiKey.description: Your Lob API key (sign up at https://dashboard.lob.com/).

address.description: Full single-line address, e.g. "185 Berry St San Francisco CA 94107". Use this OR the component fields, not both.

primary_line.description: Primary street address line, e.g. "185 Berry St".

name: lob_verify_address
title: Lob Verify Address
